title: Castle Village Outpost
wikitext:
{{Location Infobox |image = Castle Village Outpost |address = The Galdoran Continent, at [[Crimson Badlands]] |occupants = }} '''Castle Village Outpost''' is a watchtower in the [[Crimson Badlands]] maintained by the Adventurer's Guild from Castle Village. A minecart to the left leads to the [[Crimson Badlands|Desert Railway]] while the warp rune to the right leads to the nexus in [[Enchanted Grove]]. The door at the tower base leads directly to the tower's roof. [[Alesia]], [[Camilla]], and [[Isaac]] have a rotating schedule of shops, located at the base of the tower. [[File:castleVillageOutpostVendorSchedule.png|left|80px|Outpost Vendor Schedule]] When first visiting the location in a cutscene with Camilla, the player is provided with a Outpost Schedule, similar to Lance's, from a chest to the right of the tower that can be held in the inventory for convenience. After finishing [[Quests|Marlon's Legendary Trio Quest]] the two rewards will be located in two chests to the left near the entrance to the Desert Railway. ==[[File:Alesia Portrait.png|100px]]Alesia's Shop== Her shop is open on days 3, 4, 13, 21, 23, and 25 of each season.
